A game that will put your skills to the test.

219814.overview: In this game, you must construct correct English words by rotating columns of letters or by rotating the bottom row before the letters reach the top level. You can get extra points if you complete the level earlier by lowering the stack of letters below the second row.

419124.overview: Vager 3 is a 1987 single-player horizontal scrolling shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Walter & Johann Hirschmann and published in 64'er Spielesammlung #1.

419363.overview: Vexed is an addictive puzzle game where you must match the blocks to remove them from the level. Sometimes three blocks must be removed in a single move. Line up the blocks to stop them from connecting. If you’re left with any single blocks remaining, you'll have to start the level again.

422105.overview: Venture is a platform/puzzler hybrid where your mission is to collect objects that are always visible on screen and the difficulty comes from figuring out how to reach them. The game is notable on having no enemies, which is rare for platform games. The game is also an early sandbox as you're free to go everywhere from the get-go.

424236.overview:
A port of the 2020 ZX Spectrum game of the same name by POE GAMES.


Game details:

Long ago, an army of knights known as the Order of the Silver Cross attacked count Orlack's castle.

The mission was to annihilate the lord of shadows and all his subjects.

The battle was fierce, leaving a large number of victims on both sides.

But finally, a few knights managed to access the main crypt and confront Orlack.

The count managed to defeat a dozen warriors before being cornered by the invaders. The end had come. However, he managed to transform once again into his vampiric form, escaping between spears and arrows into the dark night of Transylvania.

Years passed and the wounds of war were healing. Earl Orlack made the lonely return home and only one word kept him alive. Vengeance.

424258.overview: Verlies is a German language fantasy themed  graphic text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Imperator Software and published in Magic Disk 64 1988/01

425462.overview: Bamse produced this game under the handle Sonny Top, and eventually added them to The SEUCK Vault. Released there as part of a six different game set, each on a separate D64. This is your basic vertically scrolling jungle shooter.

425840.overview:
Conversion of a well-known MSX game from 1985.

In Valkyr the player is in control of a spaceship which can be moved left and right. The aim is to shoot the aliens flying around and collect the precious metal they are carrying. You are up against the clock and from flying UFOs . You must shoot loads of aliens to go to the next level, if you run out of time the head alien comes at you and kills you!

There are three different stages. On the first two, the player must shoot as many aliens, while on the third the craft must be landed. The game then loops.

441361.overview: Vulgus is a public domain port of the arcade shoot em' up of the same name, released in 1987. Music by Rob Hubbard.

450713.overview: Vegas Roulette (also known as Carl Lockman's Vegas Roulette) is a single player roulette game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Carl M. Lockman, and released into the public domain in 1988.

456626.overview:
Vocabulary Sharpener is a 1987 educational vocabulary quiz program for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Scott Calamar and published in UpTime Vol.1 #08.

459057.overview: Stop the worms rising from the depths of the earth Use the keyboard in this classic game written in Basic C64 with characters !HIT IN HEAD WORMS!

459433.overview: 8 in the Árok 2025 Game Dev competition

459470.overview:
Virus: The Breakout Error is well...a 1-player Breakout/Arkanoid game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by CSD Artware and published in the following....

- Input 64 1988/10
- Digital Marketing PD #077
- Digital Marketing PD #163
- Starlight #01
- Stonysoft #0104

462476.overview: Atari 2600 Video Chess ported to VIC 20 and C-64

463405.overview: Volpe is an Italian language collect-em-up game for the C64. It was published in Super Commodore 64/128 No.37 (01/1991)

464186.overview: Vela is an Italian language 1985 watersports (sailing) game published in Next Special (N. 1 Anno I).

464188.overview: Vigilante is a 1-player only SEUCK game developed by Marco Mietta and published in Software Club N°18.

464190.overview:
Visitors is a simple fixed-screen shooter coded in BASIC in which you have to shoot the alien ships (which resemble tie fighters) from the sky.

The game was developed by Norman Milasi and published in Paper Soft 1985/43 (08.11.1985)

464497.overview:
Voz is a chess based puzzle game. The player is presented with a chess board with five chess pieces on it. It's for the player to discover which piece is which. To find out the player has twelve turns in which to name any square on the board. The game will then answer how many of the pieces can attack that particular square. At any time the player can commit a guess by entering the square coordinate followed by the piece the player thinks is in that location.

The C64 version was published as a type-in program in the book "Commodore 64 - Fun and Games Vol. 2" in 1984.

465718.overview: A single-player vertically scrolling shoot 'em up for the C64. Developed and released by TND in 2018 as part of that year's SEUCK competition.

466895.overview: "Vault of Seraphim" is the new jump & run cave crawler like his predecessor  "Catacombs of Cherubim"!

471871.overview: Curse of the Vampire (also known as Vampire's Curse) is a public domain horror themed text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed and released by Noltisoft in 2021.

474439.overview: The player takes on the role of a pilot of a combat spaceship equipped with lasers to destroy aerial targets and bombs to destroy ground targets. Whilst flying, you must watch out for tall buildings and obstacles, as you may crash into them. The challenge of the game lies in the fact that any collision means you have to start the flight all over again.

480621.overview: A classic Worms-style artillery game for the Commodore 64, with team-based battles.

481138.overview: A biomechanical shoot 'em up for the Commodore 64

482066.overview: Midnight. Professor Van Helsing has come to Castle Dracula with a whip in his hand. Before dawn he must cross the whole castle, one hour at a time: the graveyard, the chapel, the crypts, the library, the clock tower and the keep. Every room is a puzzle, and every chapter ends with something waiting for him.

482286.overview: Vector Vortex is a shoot 'em game in which you control a claw-shaped ship. You move around a space vortex and try to eliminate all enemy objects from coming through the black hole.

482573.overview: Autumn 1893. A terrifying shadow falls over London, casting a dark pall of fear across the city.

482912.overview: A fast single-screen space shooter: blast the swooping alien waves and chase the high score.

482918.overview: A top-down open-city crime game for the Commodore 64, on a 256K cartridge.
